name: LlamaV-o1 Visual Reasoning Benchmark
description: A visual reasoning benchmark designed to evaluate multi-step reasoning tasks in large language models, covering eight categories from complex visual perception to scientific reasoning with over 4,000 reasoning steps. It enables robust evaluation of LLMs' abilities to perform accurate and interpretable visual reasoning across multiple steps.
reputation: A newly introduced research benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly used in the associated paper to probe multi-step visual reasoning.
notes: Includes a novel metric assessing visual reasoning quality at individual step granularity; benchmark covers diverse categories and over 4k reasoning steps.
